import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_VAL = 10000000;
    static final int MAX_GRID = 12;
    static final int MAX_TIME = 62;
    static final int MAX_NODE = 210;
    static final int MAX_PATH = 21000;

    static class Connection {
        int dest;
        int weight;
        Connection(int d, int w) { dest = d; weight = w; }
    }

    static Connection[] link = new Connection[MAX_PATH];
    static int[] adj_list = new int[MAX_PATH];
    static int[] node_head = new int[MAX_NODE];
    static int total_links = 0;

    static void connect(int from, int to, int cap) {
        link[total_links] = new Connection(to, cap);
        adj_list[total_links] = node_head[from];
        node_head[from] = total_links++;
        link[total_links] = new Connection(from, 0);
        adj_list[total_links] = node_head[to];
        node_head[to] = total_links++;
    }

    static int[] depth = new int[MAX_NODE];
    static int[] fifo = new int[MAX_NODE * 2];
    static int[] pointer = new int[MAX_NODE];
    static int[] bucket = new int[MAX_NODE];
    static int[] queued = new int[MAX_NODE];
    static int[] prev_node = new int[MAX_NODE];

    static int dinic_max_flow(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(pointer, -1);
        Arrays.fill(prev_node, -1);
        int head = 0, tail = 0;
        fifo[tail++] = t;
        queued[t] = 1;
        bucket[0]++;
        depth[t] = 0;

        while (head < tail) {
            int u = fifo[head++];
            for (int e = node_head[u]; ~e != 0; e = adj_list[e]) {
                int v = link[e].dest;
                if (queued[v] == 0) {
                    fifo[tail++] = v;
                    queued[v] = 1;
                    depth[v] = depth[u] + 1;
                    bucket[depth[v]]++;
                    pointer[v] = node_head[v];
                }
            }
        }

        int flow = 0, min_capacity = MAX_VAL;
        int cur = s;
        prev_node[s] = s;

        while (depth[s] < t) {
            boolean extended = false;
            for (int i = pointer[cur]; ~i != 0; i = adj_list[i]) {
                if (link[i].weight != 0 && depth[link[i].dest] + 1 == depth[cur]) {
                    extended = true;
                    min_capacity = Math.min(min_capacity, link[i].weight);
                    prev_node[link[i].dest] = cur;
                    cur = link[i].dest;
                    if (cur == t) {
                        int augment = min_capacity;
                        while (cur != s) {
                            cur = prev_node[cur];
                            link[pointer[cur]].weight -= augment;
                            link[pointer[cur]^1].weight += augment;
                        }
                        flow += augment;
                        min_capacity = MAX_VAL;
                    }
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (extended) continue;

            int best_dist = t + 1;
            for (int e = node_head[cur]; ~e != 0; e = adj_list[e]) {
                if (link[e].weight != 0 && best_dist > depth[link[e].dest]) {
                    best_dist = depth[link[e].dest];
                    pointer[cur] = e;
                }
            }

            bucket[depth[cur]]--;
            if (bucket[depth[cur]] == 0) break;
            depth[cur] = best_dist + 1;
            bucket[depth[cur]]++;
            cur = prev_node[cur];
        }

        return flow;
    }

    static char[][] source_map = new char[MAX_GRID][MAX_GRID];
    static char[][] target_map = new char[MAX_GRID][MAX_GRID];
    static int[][] src_val = new int[MAX_GRID][MAX_GRID];
    static int[][] tgt_val = new int[MAX_GRID][MAX_GRID];
    static int[][][] spread = new int[MAX_TIME][MAX_GRID][MAX_GRID];
    static int[][][][][] path_dp = new int[MAX_TIME][MAX_GRID][MAX_GRID][MAX_GRID][MAX_GRID];
    static int[][] move_vec = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static int grid_size, total_steps;

    static void process_spread() {
        for (int step = 1; step <= total_steps; step++) {
            for (int r = 1; r <= grid_size; r++) {
                for (int c = 1; c <= grid_size; c++) {
                    if (spread[step-1][r][c] == 1) {
                        spread[step][r][c] = 1;
                    } else if (spread[step-1][r][c] == 2) {
                        spread[step][r][c] = 2;
                    } else {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                            int nr = r + move_vec[d][0];
                            int nc = c + move_vec[d][1];
                            if (nr >= 1 && nr <= grid_size && nc >= 1 && nc <= grid_size) {
                                if (spread[step-1][nr][nc] == 2) {
                                    spread[step][r][c] = 2;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean[][] marked = new boolean[MAX_GRID][MAX_GRID];

    static void trace(int sx, int sy, int px, int py, int step) {
        marked[px][py] = true;
        path_dp[step][sx][sy][px][py] = 1;
        if (step >= total_steps || spread[step][px][py] != 0) return;

        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
            int nx = px + move_vec[d][0];
            int ny = py + move_vec[d][1];
            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= grid_size && ny >= 1 && ny <= grid_size && !marked[nx][ny]) {
                if (spread[step][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
                trace(sx, sy, nx, ny, step + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int ignore = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 100000; i++) ignore++;

        grid_size = sc.nextInt();
        total_steps = sc.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= grid_size; j++) {
                source_map[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (source_map[i][j] == 'Z') spread[0][i][j] = 2;
                else if (source_map[i][j] == 'Y') spread[0][i][j] = 1;
                else src_val[i][j] = source_map[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= grid_size; j++) {
                target_map[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (target_map[i][j] >= '0' && target_map[i][j] <= '9') {
                    tgt_val[i][j] = target_map[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        process_spread();

        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= grid_size; j++) {
                if (src_val[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < MAX_GRID; x++) Arrays.fill(marked[x], false);
                    trace(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int k = 1; k <= total_steps; k++) {
            for (int a = 1; a <= grid_size; a++) {
                for (int b = 1; b <= grid_size; b++) {
                    for (int c = 1; c <= grid_size; c++) {
                        for (int d = 1; d <= grid_size; d++) {
                            path_dp[k][a][b][c][d] += path_dp[k-1][a][b][c][d];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int src_node = 0, dst_node = grid_size * grid_size * 2 + 1;
        Arrays.fill(node_head, -1);
        total_links = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= grid_size; j++) {
                connect(src_node, (i-1)*grid_size + j, src_val[i][j]);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= grid_size; j++) {
                connect(grid_size*grid_size + (i-1)*grid_size + j, dst_node, tgt_val[i][j]);
            }
        }

        for (int x = 1; x <= grid_size; x++) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= grid_size; y++) {
                for (int nx = 1; nx <= grid_size; nx++) {
                    for (int ny = 1; ny <= grid_size; ny++) {
                        if (src_val[x][y] != 0 && tgt_val[nx][ny] != 0 && path_dp[total_steps][x][y][nx][ny] != 0) {
                            connect((x-1)*grid_size + y, grid_size*grid_size + (nx-1)*grid_size + ny, MAX_VAL);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic_max_flow(src_node, dst_node));
    }
}
